note: Hand-authored facts the data files do not carry: badges, the source behind each card, and the reason for every 'no source'. A card without a value must have a reason here (tests enforce it). Reasons are drawn from SOURCES.md and the STOP reports.

household.source: Eurostat nrg_pc_204, household band DC (2,500-4,999 kWh/yr), all taxes and levies, EU-27 aggregate, half-yearly

industrial.source: Eurostat nrg_pc_205, non-household band ID (2,000-19,999 MWh/yr), excluding VAT and recoverable levies, EU-27 aggregate, half-yearly

wholesale.source: Ember European wholesale electricity prices (day-ahead, from ENTSO-E), monthly, demand-weighted across EU-27 member states with a price

household.source: EIA Electric Power Monthly / API v2 retail-sales, residential average price, monthly (preliminary for the latest months)

industrial.source: EIA retail-sales, industrial average price, monthly (preliminary for the latest months)

wholesale.gap: No reusable source. EIA's hub price files are ICE data republished with permission; of the seven US grid operators only CAISO (about 39 months of keyless history) and ERCOT (about 31 days) publish under terms that clearly allow reuse, and neither reaches back to 2015.

regions.name: China
regions.badge_note: Best effort: an administrative tariff from one city, low confidence.

household.source: Shanghai first-tier residential tariff (below 1 kV, first 3,120 kWh per household-year), per notice 沪发改价管(2012)020号; whether it was re-issued since is not confirmed

industrial.gap: Not measured. Only monthly provincial agency-purchase prices for default-supply commercial and industrial users exist, published on sites whose terms do not allow mirroring; they cover a shrinking slice of industry and were not adopted.

regions.name: Russia
regions.badge_note: High uncertainty: no reusable price source; generation data is Ember's estimate.

household.gap: No source. Rosstat's certificate chain is not trusted from the build environment and was not bypassed; no reusable secondary source was found.

industrial.gap: No source found: no Russian industrial price per kWh was found, and the wholesale price is deliberately not used as a proxy.

wholesale.gap: No source. The ATS day-ahead pages are unreachable from the build environment.

household.gap: Dropped. Eskom's tariffs are official but its website terms bar commercial reuse and automated collection without written consent.

wholesale.gap: No wholesale market operates (the market operator's portal reads 'Coming soon').

regions.name: United Kingdom
regions.badge_note: Official DESNZ tables on Eurostat's own consumption bands; wholesale not used.

household.source: DESNZ Quarterly Energy Prices table 5.6.2, Medium (2,500-4,999 kWh/yr, Eurostat band DC), including taxes, levies and VAT, half-yearly

industrial.source: DESNZ Quarterly Energy Prices table 5.4.2, Medium (2,000-19,999 MWh/yr, Eurostat band ID), taxes and levies but not VAT, half-yearly

wholesale.gap: Not used. Ember's UK price series does not say whether it is converted from sterling, and no independent figure exists to test it against.

mix_source.source: Ember Monthly Electricity Data (generation by source, demand, emissions intensity)

drivers_notes.carbon: EU carbon price (EUA): no free, reusable source exists (EEX auction files are not open-licensed), so it is omitted.
drivers_notes.rub: RUB per USD: the ECB stopped publishing a rouble reference rate on 2022-03-01, and the Bank of Russia's terms require the consent of the rightsholders, so no rouble rate is shown.
